name: CSV Analyzer
description: Parses CSV text and returns structure and per-column statistics (row/column counts, types, numeric min/max/mean/sum, top values). Lets an agent actually understand a spreadsheet or data export instead of guessing.

tools.name: analyze_csv
tools.description: Analyze CSV text and return column names, row count, and per-column stats (numeric summaries, or most-common values for text columns). Paste CSV content in as 'csv'.

csv.description: The raw CSV text (including a header row).

delimiter.description: Optional field delimiter (default ','). Use '\t' for TSV.
